title: Padded circuit encoding
statement: Let $C=(C_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ be a family of Boolean circuits, let $A:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and write $e_n$ for the Boolean-string encoding of $C_n$. The padded string at length $n$ is $e_n$ followed by a true bit and then by $\max(A(n)-|e_n|-1,0)$ false bits, where the subtraction is truncated at zero.
hypotheses_covered: A family of Boolean circuits indexed by input length
